state.description:
There is a large grey HVAC unit on a raised stand with a significant puddle of dark liquid pooling on the concrete floor directly beneath it. The source of the leak appears to be a stream of liquid dripping from the underside of the unit's metal frame. This pooling liquid presents an immediate slipping hazard and indicates an active equipment malfunction, such as a clogged condensate drain or internal leak. 

Unsure: I cannot tell whether the leaking liquid is simple dirty condensate water or if it contains hazardous machine fluids like oil or refrigerant.
